content:
Track: SQL Foundations
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
   - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
   - Lesson 3: Using WHERE and AND/OR Conditions
   - Lesson 4: Sorting Data with ORDER BY Clause
   - Lesson 5: Introduction to JOIN Operations
   - Lesson 6: Advanced JOIN Operations (LEFT, RIGHT, OUTER)
   - Lesson 7: Working with NULL values in SQL
   - Lesson 8: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses
   - Lesson 9: Subqueries and Nested Queries
   - Lesson 10: Introduction to Indexing and Performance Optimization

   Track: Data Cleaning and Manipulation with Python
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 2: Working with CSV files in Python
   - Lesson 3: Basic Data Manipulation with Pandas
   - Lesson 4: Advanced Data Manipulation (Merging, Grouping)
   - Lesson 5: Introduction to Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
   - Lesson 6: Handling Missing Values and Outliers in Data
   - Lesson 7: Data Normalization and Data Transformation
   - Lesson 8: Creating and Working with Custom Functions in Pandas

   Track: Data Analysis with Python (Descriptive Statistics)
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Descriptive Statistics
   - Lesson 2: Calculating Basic Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, Variance)
   - Lesson 3: Correlation and Covariance
   - Lesson 4: Exploring Data Distributions (Histograms, Boxplots)
   - Lesson 5: Performing Chi-Square Test for Independence
   - Lesson 6: Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
   - Lesson 7: Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals
   - Lesson 8: Regression Analysis (Simple Linear Regression)

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Part 2)
   - Lesson 1: Bar Charts and Scatter Plots
   - Lesson 2: Heatmaps and Contour Plots
   - Lesson 3: Area Charts and Stacked Bar Charts
   - Lesson 4: Pie Charts and Donut Charts
   - Lesson 5: Map Visualization (Geographical Data)
   - Lesson 6: Interactive Plots with Bokeh
   - Lesson 7: Creating Dynamic Reports in Python
   - Lesson 8: Final Project: Design a Data Visualization for a Real-World Dataset

   Track: Introduction to Machine Learning (Supervised Learning)
   - Lesson 1: Basics of Supervised Learning
   - Lesson 2: Linear Regression
   - Lesson 3: Logistic Regression
   - Lesson 4: Decision Trees and Random Forests
   - Lesson 5: Naive Bayes Classifiers
   - Lesson 6: Support Vector Machines (SVM)
   - Lesson 7: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
   - Lesson 8: Model Evaluation Metrics (Accuracy, Precision, Recall)

   Track: Practical Project: Applying Data Analysis and ML Skills
   - Lesson 1: Choosing a Real-World Dataset for Analysis
   - Lesson 2: Preprocessing the Dataset
   - Lesson 3: Data Exploration and Visualization
   - Lesson 4: Feature Engineering and Selection
   - Lesson 5: Model Development and Training
   - Lesson 6: Model Evaluation, Validation, and Optimization
   - Lesson 7: Deployment of the Model in a Real-World Scenario
   - Lesson 8: Final Project Presentation and Reflection
